workflow: Leon requested seven fixes first, then the full run with each new icon pushed and shown immediately.

icons.name: Bulwark
icons.action: Wick braces a tall riot shield in a low side-on lunge, bullets bouncing off its front, a tiny Wick silhouette crouched safe behind it.

icons.name: Shrug It Off
icons.action: Wick, half-hunched, straightens with one big shoulder shrug that flings a heavy iron shackle off its back to clang away.

icons.name: Used to the Pain
icons.action: Knocked to one knee by a big brick that just bounced off its head, Wick is already springing up, fists raised.

icons.name: Scar Tissue
icons.action: Wick sits calmly and holds its riveted, patch-plated arm straight into a big tongue of fire, as if warming it.

icons.name: Wind on the Skin
icons.action: Wick kneels, eyes closed, one mitten raised into a long wind streak that curls past it and ends at a pair of eyes in the dark.

icons.name: Bedside Manner
icons.action: Wick leans in and clasps a hand entering frame in both mittens, a warm firm handshake, head tilted to listen.

icons.name: Breaching Strike
icons.action: Wick swings a sledgehammer bigger than itself through a sandbag barricade in a full twisting follow-through, sandbags flying back.

icons.name: Grapple
icons.action: Wick clamps itself around a huge armoured forearm entering frame, arms and legs wrapped tight, boots off the ground, refusing to let go.

icons.name: Into the Dark
icons.action: Seen from behind, cape prominent, Wick strides without pause through a pitch-black doorway that looms over it.

icons.name: Iron Stomach
icons.action: Wick sits with legs stuck out, happily slurping straight from a dented tin can that pours out thick wavy stink lines.

icons.name: Grim Reaper
icons.action: Wick, cape pulled up into a hood, leans casually on a scythe taller than itself as three AP pips spark up off the blade; a shadow flees at the frame edge.

icons.name: Bone Talk
icons.action: Wick leans right into the viewer, screen close and foreshortened, slowly clacking a big pair of pliers between them.

icons.name: Wall Run
icons.action: Wick runs sideways along a vertical wall, body parallel to the ground, cape streaming, above a gap that drops away below.

icons.name: Roll With It
icons.action: Wick tumbles in a tight forward roll, curled into a ball, as a big sword blade sweeps through the air just above it.

icons.name: Origami Hands
icons.action: Wick squats on its heels folding a scrap sheet into a big toothy bear trap, the last fold snapping into place.

icons.name: Running Reload
icons.action: Wick sprints mid-stride, slapping a fresh magazine into a big pistol, motion lines behind both feet.

icons.name: Rounding Up
icons.action: Wick leans on a battery cell as tall as itself, cheekily pushing its half-full charge mark up to the top with one mitten.

icons.name: Catch
icons.action: Wick leaps and snatches a grenade out of the air one-handed, body already twisting to wind back for the throw.

icons.name: Sleight of Hand
icons.action: On tiptoe, Wick slips a round fused bomb into a big coat pocket hanging into frame, its other mitten raised for hush.

icons.name: Shadow Step
icons.action: Wick crouches with its back pressed flat to a chunk of broken wall, peeking round the edge, one boot lifted for the next dash.

icons.name: Jury-Rig
icons.action: Wick kneels, bracing a cracked rifle wrapped in thick tape on its knee as it coughs out one last sputtering shot.

icons.name: Hot-Swap
icons.action: Mid-twirl on one boot, Wick flips a pistol behind its back from one mitten to the other, a curved swap arrow looping around its waist.

icons.name: Got You in My Sight
icons.action: Wick lunges and snatches the hem of a dashed-outline cloak as it fades to nothing; its wearer is already gone.

icons.name: Eyes in the Back
icons.action: Seen from behind, cape prominent, Wick holds a big round hand-mirror up over its shoulder, watching the way it isn't facing.
icons.screen: One wide eye, seen in the mirror

icons.name: Hold the Stroke
icons.action: Wick braces an Evoker in both mittens, knees buckling, as a tall stack of unreleased geometric sigil strokes hovers queued over its muzzle.

icons.name: Parallel Thought
icons.action: Wick sits with one knee up, drawing a new geometric sigil with its Evoker while a finished sigil still spins on its free mitten.

icons.name: Footnote
icons.action: Wick pops up from behind a giant open book with blank ruled pages, one mitten raised, finger pointing skyward to make a point.

icons.name: Lab Coat
icons.action: Wick squats inside a curling cloud of gas, holding up a flask to compare it with the fumes, unbothered as the gas parts around it.

icons.name: Overruled!
icons.action: Wick leaps off both boots, swinging a gavel bigger than its head down onto a sounding block, a motion arc behind it.

icons.name: Burden of Proof
icons.action: Wick holds an empty box upside down at arm's length and shakes it; nothing falls out but a single dust puff.

icons.name: Mirage
icons.action: Wick leans halfway out through a dashed-outline wall that it projects from one raised mitten, giving the trick away.

icons.name: Blueprint
icons.action: Wick kneels over a big unrolled plan, drawing a bold route arrow across it with a chalk stick.

icons.name: Detective's Eye
icons.action: Wick lies prone, chin on the ground, peering through a magnifying glass bigger than its head at one out-of-place footprint.

icons.name: Pattern Lock
icons.action: Wick leans back just far enough as a big blade thrusts past its screen from frame edge, mittens loose and casual.

icons.name: Talks Broke Down
icons.action: From a low squat, Wick heaves a negotiating table up and over, cups and blank papers flying, already grinning.

icons.name: Crowd Pleaser
icons.action: Wick crowd-surfs on its back, arms flung wide, borne along on a wave of tiny raised hands that fills the lower third.

icons.name: Shared Breath
icons.action: Wick kneels, eyes closed, one mitten on its lantern heart; a single ribbon runs from the heart out of frame to a hand gripping it.

icons.name: Lay Down Arms
icons.action: Wick steps close and gently presses a rifle barrel, poking in from frame edge, down toward the ground with one open mitten.

icons.name: Soulmate
icons.action: Wick curls over a tiny Wick silhouette, cape spread over both like a tent, as cracks from a blow spread across Wick's own back.

icons.name: Rally Cry
icons.action: In a deep lunge, Wick drives a torn, blank banner pole into the ground with both mittens, mouth wide in a shout.

icons.name: Sweet Talker
icons.action: Wick lounges on one elbow on thin air, offering a long-stemmed rose; a thorn has pricked its mitten, a tiny pain star at the spot.

icons.name: Double Meaning
icons.action: Wick sits sideways on a low ledge, winking at the viewer, as its single blank speech balloon forks into two tails pointing opposite ways.

icons.name: Heart Overload
icons.action: Wick lunges, thrusting an Emanator gauntlet that pours out a flowing ribbon blast, while thick cracks spider out from its own lantern heart.

icons.name: Resonance
icons.action: Wick crouches holding up a large tuning fork that hums in concentric rings, catching a soul ribbon drifting in from off frame.

icons.name: Old Tongue
icons.action: Wick kneels nose-close to a tall cracked stone slab, tracing its carved spirals and dots (no letters) with one mitten.

icons.name: Rite in the Field
icons.action: Wick lies flat in a shallow trench, hammering a carved ward stake into the dirt with its fist as streaks fly overhead.

icons.name: You Get Used to It
icons.action: Wick holds a big umbrella over a tiny Wick silhouette while a rain of scribbly squiggles pours down, looking utterly bored.

icons.name: Flat Line
icons.action: Wick sits bolt upright on a stool, teacup raised halfway, staring dead at the viewer without moving.

icons.name: Litany
icons.action: Wick kneels with head tilted up, prayer beads wound through both mittens, singing, thin radiant lines fanning above it.

icons.name: Holy Ordnance
icons.action: Wick raises a rifle magazine overhead in both mittens like a relic, thick radiant rays bursting from it.

icons.name: Red Line
icons.action: Wick leans far back, heels dug in at a thick line on the ground, as a crooked beckoning hand reaches from the far side.
